sources.quote: Create specification files that define WHAT the system should do.

items.note: Spec content quality (observable behavior, error conditions, testable scenarios) is a semantic judgement that no kind here expresses.

sources.quote: Good spec content: - Observable behavior users or downstream systems rely on - Inputs, outputs, and error conditions - External constraints (security, privacy, reliability, compatibility) - Scenarios that can be tested or explicitly validated

items.note: Also covers schema-032, schema-033 and schema-046: each listed capability has its spec at the exact path specs/<capability-path>/spec.md.

sources.quote: Create one spec file per capability listed in the proposal's Capabilities section.

sources.quote: use the exact path from the proposal at `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md`. Any path segment newly introduced in the proposal must be kebab-case.

sources.quote: Before writing anything, compare the capabilities the proposal lists with the `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md` files that already exist, and start with the first capability that has no file.

items.note: Spec-file existence is checked by the schema-026 item; this item checks that the proposal declares at least one capability.

sources.quote: There must be at least one spec file unless the change's `.openspec.yaml` sets `skip_specs: true` ... If the proposal lists no capabilities and `skip_specs` is not set, revisit the proposal first.

unitemized.reason: Preserving the full capability path is already checked by the openspec.capabilities listed_have_specs item under schema-031, which requires each listed capability's spec at its exact specs/<capability-path>/spec.md.
Same check as schema-031's listed_have_specs item (each new capability's spec at the exact proposal path); a separate item would duplicate it.
The rule applies only to modified capabilities. No predicate in the reference language can tell whether a delta targets an existing capability, so applies_when cannot express it (rule 7).
--store is allowed only when a registered standalone store exists. Whether one is registered cannot be expressed as an observable predicate.
'Every listed capability has its file' is the same check as schema-031's openspec.capabilities listed_have_specs item.
